Two live guards remain: no buffApply anywhere carries value 15.01 (fails under the nearest-wrong 'radius laundered into projectileExplosionPct/attackDamagePct'), and the override prose must still mention the line (no silent drop).

Trigger identity is moot while the payload is unmodellable — no trigger assertion written. Recorded here so a later session does not mistake the silence for a FAITHFUL ruling: if an explosion-radius primitive ever lands, the trigger is per-full-charge (shotFired on an always-charging RL, or chargeCounter count 1), NOT interval and NOT burst-keyed.

Rung-by-rung buffApply counts at each of the first three cast frames prove the escalating ladder: cast 1 = {atkPct 5.35}, cast 2 = {5.35 x2, critDamagePct 22.34}, cast 3 adds critRatePct 15.51. RED under the nearest-wrong 'all three rungs on every cast' — constructed explicitly as the flatLadder counterfactual (three plain self-buffs on burstCast), which is asserted to fire critRatePct at cast 1 and to move vesti's total.
Every rung's buffApply has expiresFrame - frame === 2700 and durationShots === null. RED under the taxonomy-#2 nearest-wrong (a round-count duration) and under any 30s/permanent misreading.

In the two-B3 withHelm fixture, count(rung-1 applications) === count(vesti burstCast), asserted alongside fullBurstStart > vesti burstCast so the two triggers provably disagree in this fixture. RED under the nearest-wrong fullBurstEnter keying, which would over-credit by every helm-opened rotation.
The set of targetSlug values across all three rung stats is exactly ['vesti'] in the 4-unit fixture. RED under an allies-scoped misread, which would hand liter/crown/helm the ATK and crit buffs.

Burst-slot damage after the cast frame lands on exactly 18 distinct frames spaced exactly 60 frames, starting cast+60. RED under a wrong interval, a wrong duration, and under the taxonomy-#5 DoT-multiplication failure (a second assertion pins the NEXT cast's window to 18 frames too, so per-cast instances cannot accumulate).

⚑ kit-silent split-vs-merge (taxonomy #5). Read PER CONTAINER: per-tick atkPct summed across all instances on that frame === 31.12. Encoding-agnostic (one dot at 31.12 or two at 15.56 both pass). fullBurstStart.endFrame - frame is ~300 frames (5s) for every complete window in the solo fixture; the counterfactual that strips fullBurstExtend restores ~600 (10s) and changes vesti's total. A third assertion checks the shortening is TEAM-wide: every in-FB damage instance from any unit falls inside a 5s window. RED under the line being dropped, self-scoped, or signed as an extension.

fixtures: TWO base comps, both scope-lock, deterministic (no seed). (1) controlComp('vesti', false) = liter (B1) / crown (B2) / vesti (B3), boss Fire, focus vesti — vesti is the SOLE Burst III so she casts every rotation, which is the only way to reach Survival Instinct 3 inside 180s and read all three ladder rungs; dropping the fixed-B3 `helm` slot also removes her ATK/crit auras from the rung readings. (2) controlComp('vesti', true) adds `helm`, a SECOND Burst III, so helm opens some Full Bursts that vesti did not cast — the only configuration in which burst-cast and full-burst-enter triggers diverge, and the test asserts that gap is non-zero before using it. Two counterfactuals via withPatchedOverride (committed JSON untouched): flatLadder replaces skill2 with three plain simultaneous self-buffs (nearest-wrong for escalation), noShorten strips every fullBurstExtend effect from the burst slot (nearest-wrong for the FB-duration debuff). 4 sim runs total, all hoisted.
gaps: it.skip — skill1 'Explosion Radius ▲ 15.01% for 10 sec': no explosion-radius / AoE primitive exists in EffectDef, and hit AREA cannot move damage against the single, partless scope-lock boss. Modelling it needs an area mechanic the engine does not have. Two live guards stand in: no buffApply carries value 15.01 (catches radius laundered into a damage stat), and the override prose must still name the line.

NOT ASSERTED (deliberate, stated in the header) — crit-eligibility of the burst rider. Whether a flatDamage rider crits is an engine-wide policy (RIDERCRIT), not a vesti kit line; pinning it in this file would test the engine under this unit's name. It matters here because SI2/SI3 grant Critical Damage and Critical Rate, so the rider's crit flag decides whether the ladder feeds her own nuke — worth an explicit driver ruling.

⚑ UNRESOLVED, isolated to one test — the two-Missile-Container split-vs-merge (per-tick 31.12% vs 15.56%). Kit-silent; read per-container per the literal text. Recipe: count damage popups per second during her burst on a focus recording.

⚑ UNRESOLVED, no assertion — whether the burst rider's cumulative reading is right. The 'each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it' sentence is shared with skill2, where cumulative is unarguable, so cumulative is the literal read (SI3 = 760.06% total). If a recording shows a single ~302% popup at SI3 instead of three, the tiers REPLACE and this test goes red by design.
